title: Bạn có thể đưa tôi vào danh sách chờ được không?
englishTitle: Can you put me on the waiting list?
pronunciation: Ban co the dua toi vao danh sach cho duoc khong
summary: Ask a counter or host to add your name when a table, tour, seat, or appointment is full.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: This is for the moment after no availability, when staying nearby is still worth it.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Give your name, party size, phone number, or time window after the question.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Danh sách chờ is the waiting-list phrase; đưa tôi vào asks them to put you on it.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Time, today, and tomorrow-morning cards help if they offer a different slot instead.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Best at restaurants, clinics, tours, salons, or ticket counters where cancellations may open a spot.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Be ready to write your name or phone number. Some places call out a name instead of messaging.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Booking, opening-time, and move-it-later cards help if the wait turns into rescheduling.
